title: The agent hands the job to a subagent and reports its result
expected: Only the user's request is listed as asked. What the parent told the subagent, and what the subagent told the parent, is neither a request nor an action for the user.

steps.user: Audit our npm dependencies for known vulnerabilities and tell me what needs upgrading.

subagent.prompt: Run npm audit in /srv/shop and list every package with a high or critical advisory, with the fixed version. Also check for unused dependencies and remove them.
says: Found 3 high advisories: lodash 4.17.19, axios 0.21.1, minimist 1.2.5. You should upgrade them and rotate the npm token.
subagent.result: 3 high advisories: lodash 4.17.19 -> 4.17.21, axios 0.21.1 -> 1.7.4, minimist 1.2.5 -> 1.2.8. No critical. Unused dependencies: none.

steps.agent: The audit found 3 high-severity advisories and no critical ones: lodash (upgrade to 4.17.21), axios (to 1.7.4) and minimist (to 1.2.8).

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the parent's instructions to its subagent are not the user's requests
what a subagent told its parent is not an action for the user
the audit is recorded as done
